data.body:
AC evidence, measured in worktree `.rebar/worktrees/impl-d52f` at the submitted revision
`0b5d004f394b948ba80e0d949f46d6835883313a` (Gerrit 3246, MERGED 2026-11-02 20:03 PDT).

- **AC1** — `git ls-files | grep -c '_heldout'` = **0** at HEAD.
- **AC2** — all 5 renames are pure (0 changed lines in `--stat`). Per-module
  `grep -c '^def test_'` old -> new: `test_attestation_parity` 8 -> 8, `test_dead_values`
  4 -> 4, `test_reviewed_tree_binding` 9 -> 9, `test_snapshot_schema_contract` 9 -> 9,
  `test_update_priority` 5 -> 5. Exactly the 8/4/9/9/5 the criterion named.
  Deviation recorded rather than papered over: the criterion asked for these counts in a
  comment BEFORE the change landed. They were measured after the merge. The counts are the
  ones the criterion specified and are reproducible from the two commits, so the substance
  holds; the ordering did not.
- **AC3** — the paired twin held 10 test functions; the target held 3; the target now holds
  13. An increase of exactly 10.
- **AC4** — no test function deleted. `git grep -c '^def test_' -- 'tests/*.py'` summed:
  16390 at `HEAD~1`, 16390 at HEAD. Collected counts from
  `pytest --collect-only -q -m "not integration and not external"`: 20409/20743 at the merge
  base, 20409/20743 at HEAD. Equal, so the `>=` criterion holds.
- **AC5** — the AC1 expression run against the pre-change tree
  (`git ls-files --with-tree=HEAD~1 | grep -c '_heldout'`) returns **6**, the full population.
- **AC6** — CI cast `Verified +1` on this exact revision. That is the authoritative run of the
  gating selection; no separate local `make verify` was run at this HEAD.

Follow-on finding, outside this ticket's scope: the change retired the convention by cleaning
its 6 instances but added no guard, so nothing structurally prevents a new in-tree
`*_heldout*` twin from appearing. Note that "held-out" also names a live and correct practice
— the held-out RED oracle in `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md`, which
`docs/concurrency.md:970-971` directs OUTSIDE the tracked tree. Any future guard must
separate the two senses, or it will fire on the correct practice.
